name: Original Turtle Rules (Faith) System 1/2 Donchian with N-unit pyramiding
author: FengkieJ

indicators: Donchian(20) entry, Donchian(10) exit (S1; S2 = 55/20), ATR(20)=N, stop 2N, pyramid every 0.5N up to 4 units, unit = 1% equity/(N*dollars per point)
exit: exit long when low <= exit Donchian lower(10) or opposite entry signal; short mirror
stop_loss: 2N from latest unit (stops of earlier units re-raised)
position_sizing: 1% of equity risk unit; max 4 units; pyramid threshold 0.5N
filters: S1 skip-after-winner filter described in comments but not clearly implemented
implementation_notes: S1 'skip if last trade profitable' rule referenced (last_was_profitable var) - verify it is enforced. Intrabar breakout fills assumed at close price in jesse. Jesse note: README states these are code examples, not profitable strategies.
